name: ippo_prior_probe_700_decision_tree

probe.scenario: H1PROBE700: 3x3 grid, 18 flows x 350 veh/h = 6300 veh/h (700 veh/h per intersection)
probe.role: mechanism probe only; never merged into confirmatory tests; n=2 per method cannot confirm any direction

decision_rule_primary: per-seed paired sign of mean U (demand_service_time over 5 eval seeds): IPPO-P better in both seeds = positive; worse in both = negative; split = indeterminate
decision_rule_secondary_guard: completion rates and teleports must show no method-specific failure; if either method shows completion collapse or teleport, interpret as protocol anomaly before any mechanism claim

positive.condition: IPPO-P U better in 2/2 seeds (paired training-curve direction must not contradict)
positive.conclusion_writing: prior benefit has a pressure floor: when load is insufficient the bias cost dominates; near saturation the stabilization benefit dominates; v2 negative result is reported as a mid-point on the pressure gradient; paper mainline (IPPO-P, confirmed 2x2 results) unchanged

negative.conclusion_writing: on 3x3 topology the prior bias cost dominates and does not recover with load; claim scope restricted to compact 2x2-like networks; v2 and probe both reported as boundary/negative evidence in limitations

indeterminate.conclusion_writing: probe is inconclusive; v2 remains a single-point negative result; no mechanism claim about pressure floor is made
indeterminate.further_experiments: none; no additional probes; proceed to writing with scope-restricted claims

anti_goals: no post-hoc reinterpretation after seeing results
no additional seeds/scenarios added to rescue any branch
probe results never described as confirmatory

context.confirmed_main_result: IPPO-P vs IPPO on H1/H2/H3 (2x2-style grids), n=10 fresh seeds: +1.712%, 10/10, exact p=0.001953 (frozen protocol ippo_prior_confirmation_v1)
context.v2_boundary_result: 3x3 @ 5400 veh/h (600/intersection): IPPO-P -0.997%, 0/5 seeds, global service-quality degradation with completion unchanged
context.open_question: whether v2 negative effect is a pressure-floor phenomenon or a 3x3-topology phenomenon
